As artificial intelligence drives demand for larger, more powerful semiconductor devices,[advanced packaging](https://www.lamresearch.com/products/our-solutions/packaging-solutions/?highlight=advanced%20packaging) has become a critical area of innovation. To address the growing size and complexity of AI chip packages, the industry is[exploring panel-level processing](https://newsroom.lamresearch.com/wafer-to-panel-lam-scaling-advanced-packaging-panel-level-processing?blog=true) , an emerging manufacturing approach that could improve efficiency, scalability, and cost effectiveness compared to traditional wafer-based methods.


## What Is Panel-Level Processing in Semiconductor Engineering?


Panel-level processing is an advanced semiconductor packaging approach that uses rectangular panels instead of traditional round wafers, enabling greater manufacturing area efficiency and potentially supporting larger, more complex chip packages.

## FAQ


**What is panel-level packaging in semiconductor manufacturing?**


Panel-level packaging (PLP) is an advanced manufacturing approach that processes square or rectangular panels instead of round wafers, which improves area utilization and scalability for large advanced packages.


**Why is panel-level processing important for AI chips?**


AI workloads require larger dies and denser interconnects, which increasingly exceed wafer efficiency limits. Panels offer a more scalable path to high-volume manufacturing.


**How does panel-level processing differ from wafer-level packaging?**


The main difference is substrate format. Wafer-level packaging uses circular wafers, while panel-level processing uses rectangular panels that can provide greater usable manufacturing area.


**What challenges does panel-level packaging introduce?**


Key challenges include uniformity control, yield management, automation, throughput, and establishing industry-wide panel standards.


**What role does Lam Research play in panel-level processing?**


Lam is developing process technologies designed to deliver precision, uniformity, and scalability for advanced panel-level manufacturing. To that end, Lam is investing in tool innovation and infrastructure, including our Salzburg Panel Center of Excellence, to accelerate R&D, qualification, and high-volume manufacturing (HVM) readiness.
